verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only generic infrastructure claims (scaling CPU/RAM, adding replicas for services, private/public networking) but no mention of a managed Postgres offering with point-in-time recovery, database replicas, or high-availability configuration. One community remark even jokes about backup/security handling, but this isn't concrete evidence against a stated capability—there's simply no claim of PITR/HA Postgres to evaluate. missing for 10: managed Postgres provisioning docs, point-in-time recovery feature, database replica/HA configuration, any first-party or independent confirmation of database-level resiliency features.
